content.value_statement: Medical device teams need consistent QMS documentation and audit preparation. This skill guides ISO 13485 processes, reviews, CAPA, supplier quality, and certification readiness.
actual_capabilities: Designs ISO 13485 QMS implementation plans and gap analysis steps.
Explains document control lifecycle requirements for controlled medical device records.
Structures management review inputs, decisions, and follow-up actions.
Plans internal audit programs for process, system, and product audits.
Guides design controls, risk management integration, and supplier quality processes.
Defines QMS performance metrics for audits, CAPA, training, and customer feedback.
limitations: Does not replace a certified ISO 13485 auditor or regulatory counsel.
Cannot verify a company certificate, audit record, or legal compliance without supplied evidence.
Included scripts and references are placeholders, not working automation assets.
Guidance must be adapted to each product, market, and quality system.

use_cases.title: Plan QMS implementation
use_cases.description: Create a phased ISO 13485 rollout plan with gaps, owners, documents, training, and review checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Prepare audit activities
use_cases.description: Build internal audit scope, criteria, checklists, evidence requests, and follow-up actions for QMS processes.

use_cases.title: Organize management review
use_cases.description: Compile review inputs, quality metrics, CAPA status, supplier issues, decisions, and action tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Create a QMS gap checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a first ISO 13485 readiness review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ISO 13485 QMS gap checklist for a medical device company. Include clause areas, expected evidence, owner roles, and priority levels.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a document control procedure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for controlled document governance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a document control procedure outline for ISO 13485. Cover creation, review, approval, release, change control, retention, and obsolete document handling.

prompt_templates.title: Build an internal audit plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for risk-based audit scheduling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a risk-based internal audit plan for our QMS. Include audit frequency, process scope, auditor competence, evidence requests, and CAPA follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare management review inputs
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for leadership review preparation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a management review agenda and input package for ISO 13485. Include audit results, complaints, CAPA, supplier quality, process metrics, and decisions needed.

output_examples.input: Prepare management review inputs for the next quarterly QMS review.
output: Agenda covering audit results, customer feedback, CAPA status, supplier performance, process metrics, and improvement needs.
Decision log structure for actions, owners, due dates, effectiveness checks, and follow-up status.
Evidence list for complaint trends, training records, nonconformities, and supplier quality issues.

output_examples.input: Create an internal audit checklist for document control.
output: Audit criteria mapped to ISO 13485 document control expectations.
Questions for document approval, distribution, revision control, obsolete copies, and record retention.
Evidence requests for document registers, approval records, change histories, and controlled templates.

best_practices: Provide current QMS scope, device class, and target markets before requesting procedures.
Ask for clause references when creating audit criteria or procedure outlines.
Have qualified personnel review generated content before release or audit use.
anti_patterns: Using generated procedures as approved documents without internal review.
Asking for legal certification claims without evidence from an accredited body.
Mixing ISO 13485, FDA QSR, and MDR requirements without defining jurisdiction.

faq.question: Can this skill certify my QMS?
faq.answer: No. Certification requires an accredited certification body and objective audit evidence.

faq.question: Can it create complete QMS procedures?
faq.answer: It can draft outlines and process content. Your organization must review, approve, and control final documents.

faq.question: Does it support internal audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help plan scope, criteria, checklists, evidence requests, findings, and CAPA follow-up.

faq.question: What inputs improve the results?
faq.answer: Provide QMS scope, products, target markets, process owners, current procedures, audit history, and known gaps.

faq.question: Does it run automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The included script and reference files are placeholders and do not provide working automation.
